name: Should I install garage trim myself or hire a professional contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I install garage trim myself or hire a professional contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: While experienced homeowners can tackle basic trim, hiring a professional finish contractor ensures precise miter joints, weather-tight sealing, and proper door alignment. Garage doors experience constant movement, vibration, and outdoor exposure, meaning improperly spaced trim can bind the door panels or allow hidden leaks into wall cavities. A professional also identifies whether soft trim stems from roof runoff or framing rot beneath the surface. With an owner-operated finish contractor managing the project, you get experienced carpentry, durable fasteners, and seamless caulking that stands up to daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional ensures accurate cuts, proper door clearances, weather-tight seals, and early detection of hidden framing rot that DIY projects often miss.
